newsitem.title: USA: Petco to acquire Pet Food Warehouse.
newsitem.headline: Petco to acquire Pet Food Warehouse.

text.p: Petco Animal Supplies Inc. said Friday it will acquire rival pet supply store chain Pet Food Warehouse Inc. in a stock deal valued at about $52.25 million.
The addition of Pet Food Warehouse's 28 stores will boost Petco's nationwide chain to 305 stores.
Under the definitive agreement, Petco will offer 0.2 share of its stock for each Pet Food share, or a total of about 1.9 million Petco shares, in a tax-free pooling of interests.
San Diego, Calif.-based Petco has 16.3 million shares outstanding and Pet Food has 9.4 million shares outstanding, it said.
Petco's stock fell $1.50 to $27.50, while Pet Food edged up 11 cents to $5.23 on Nasdaq at mid-afternoon.
The deal, approved by the boards of both companies, is expected to boost earnings as of 1997, Petco said.
The transaction is expected to close in December, subject to approval by Pet Food shareholders and regulators.
Minneapolis, Minn.-based Pet Food operates 28 pet food and supply stores in the upper Midwest, with annual sales of more than $70 million.
Petco now operates 277 stores, including 212 superstores in 15 states and Washington, D.C.
